rules.source: wheelRgb(_frame*3 + i*768/40), 30 source FPS; snapshot zero has already executed tick()
rules.phase: LED phase=i/40; global phase advances seconds/(256/30), forward modulo one; 16-bit per-pixel phase plus 8-bit color-zone weight
rules.background: Invert the static artwork's chromatic wheel mixture to a phase; equal phases share the same palette lookup as the LED regions
rules.texture: Fixed luminance texture and saturation; retain the source color wheel's intrinsic intensity variation; no added blinking or spatial deformation
rules.material: Neutral body and propeller materials are excluded; white emitter cores remain bright
rules.limits: Image-space background phase is an appearance mapping, not a 3D illumination solver. One artwork plus a compact phase map and 256x1 source RGB lookup; no generated frame sequence or video is used at runtime.
